description: This file is an implementation of a macOS BrowserWindowController class in Objective-C, managing a WKWebView, handling navigation, UI components, dialogs, and web content interactions for a browser-like application.

classes.name: PlaywrightNSTextFinder
classes.description: A subclass of NSTextFinder with a callback for hiding the find interface.

classes.name: CustomWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow that constrains window frame to prevent exceeding screen bounds.

classes.name: BrowserWindowController
classes.description: Main controller managing a web browsing window, encapsulating WKWebView management, navigation handling, dialogs, UI interactions, and web content processing.

methods.name: windowDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes UI components, configures WKWebView, sets delegates, and prepares the web view for presentation.

methods.name: fetch:
methods.description: Loads the URL specified in the urlText field.

methods.name: loadURLString:
methods.description: Loads the provided URL string into the web view.

methods.name: loadHTMLString:
methods.description: Loads the provided HTML string into the web view.

methods.name: reload:
methods.description: Reloads the current content of the web view.

methods.name: goBack:
methods.description: Navigates the web view backward in history.

methods.name: goForward:
methods.description: Navigates the web view forward in history.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationAction:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or cancel a navigation action.

methods.name: webView:didFinishNavigation:
methods.description: Handles actions upon completion of navigation, including updating the window title.

methods.name: updateTitle:
methods.description: Updates the window title based on the web page's title or URL.

methods.name: webView:createWebViewWithConfiguration:forNavigationAction:windowFeatures:
methods.description: Creates a new web view for targeted links or window requests.

methods.name: saveAsPDF:
methods.description: Saves the web view content as a PDF file.

methods.name: saveAsWebArchive:
methods.description: Saves the web view content as a Web Archive.
